title: The Woman Opposite
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：subject　|　正文 412 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 subject 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The train from the county town took four hours, and for three of them nobody spoke. My grandmother had warned me that people in the countryside are reserved, which turned out to be nonsense: they simply wait for a ① subject. Mine arrived eleven minutes after we left the station, from the woman opposite: 'Is that your grandmother's house, the one with the pear tree?'

After that we talked about pears for fifty kilometres. We had returned to the same subject three times without noticing. Then she said something I have never forgotten: 'Everybody on this line has lost somebody to the city.' It seemed a strange leap to ② change the subject from fruit to absence, but she had made the connection herself and simply expected me to follow it.

At school I had been taught that geography is a dry ③ subject, full of rainfall figures and nothing else. That afternoon I learned otherwise. She asked where exactly I lived, how much the bus cost, and whether it rained more than it used to. I had almost no answers, and my ignorance ④ subjected me to a kind but very thorough questioning about bus timetables.

Every subject, however dry, has a door into it somewhere. Every conversation on that train followed rules I could not have written down. History lessons, she said, are not the same thing as talk: what she wanted was not my knowledge but my attention, and I have never found either easy to give. My history teacher would have disapproved of her chronology; my English teacher would have admired her pauses. Everything else that summer was only a preamble to that ⑤ subject.

She got off at a station with one platform and no ticket office, and I never learned her name. Two things stayed with me. First, the best travelling companion asks questions whose answers they cannot predict. Second, she never once told me what to think: she kept returning to the same ⑥ subject until I did the work myself. The ⑦ subject of every other conversation I had that summer has long since faded. Since then almost everybody I have met has been ⑧ subject to one quiet test of hers — are they curious about a place, or only about what they can take away from it? Every village I have visited since has become the ⑨ subject of my own small notebook. And I still have no good answer to anything anybody asks me ⑩ on the subject of bus fares.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 话题；谈论的内容
C. n. （关注、研究的）对象；题材
D. v. 使遭受；让……经历（subject sb to sth）
E. v. 使顺从；使经受考验
F. 固定搭配：change the subject 转换话题
G. 固定搭配：the subject of ... ……的话题／主题
H. 固定搭配：on the subject of 关于；谈到……

items.q: they simply wait for a subject
to change the subject from fruit to absence
my ignorance subjected me to a kind but thorough questioning
returning to the same subject until I did the work myself
The subject of every other conversation
has been subject to one quiet test
has become the subject of my own small notebook
on the subject of bus fares

answers.why: wait for a subject 意为“等一个话题”，乡下人并不冷漠，只是等人开口。
change the subject 意为“转换话题”，此处指从梨树转到离别这个话题。
geography is a dry subject 中的 subject 是“学科、科目”。
subject sb to sth 是动词用法，意为“使某人遭受／经历”，指作者被连串盘问。
that subject 回指上面谈到的内容，仍是名词“话题”。
同样是“话题”，说明她反复回到同一个话题直到作者自己去想。
the subject of＋名词，意为“……的话题”，此处指那年夏天其他所有谈话的主题。
be subject to＋考验，意为“经受、被置于……之下”，每个人都通过了她这项安静的测试。
成为笔记本记录的“对象、题材”，是名词的对象义。
on the subject of 意为“关于……”，此处指关于票价作者至今答不上来。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 他们只是在等一个可以开口的话题。（subject n.）
她把话题从梨树换到了离别。（change the subject）
学校里一直说地理是一门枯燥的学科。（subject n.）
我的无知让我受到了一连串温和的追问。（subject sb to）
那次谈话成了我笔记本里记录的题材。（the subject of）
关于巴士票价，我到现在也答不上来。（on the subject of）
answers: They were simply waiting for a subject.
She changed the subject from pear trees to absence.
At school geography is always described as a dry subject.
My ignorance subjected me to a series of kind questions.
That conversation became the subject of a notebook of mine.
On the subject of bus fares I still have no good answer.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 subject 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: People in the countryside are not reserved; on that train they were simply waiting for a subject.
We talked about pears for fifty kilometres before she changed the subject to everybody the line had lost.
Geography had always been a dry subject at school, yet she subjected me to an hour of questions about bus fares.
She never told me what to think; she just kept returning to the same subject until I worked it out.
Everything else that summer was only a preamble, and the subject of most conversations has long since faded.
Every village I visit now becomes the subject of a small notebook, and on the subject of curiosity I know exactly who taught me.
